title: PH, European, Asian police eye closer intelligence-sharing vs terrorism

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and seven other Asian and European countries are exploring closer intelligence-sharing and cross-border police cooperation amid emerging threats of terrorism and violent extremism. In a statement on Friday, the Delegation of the European Union (EU) to the Philippines said police representatives from the Philippines, France, Indonesia, Ireland, Japan, Malaysia, Spain and Thailand gathered at Camp Crame in Quezon City from Nov. 24 to 26 for a counterterrorism conference. Specialists from Europol’s European Counter Terrorism Centre also attended the three-day meeting.
